cost_model.basis: all measured dual-lane workload samples; percentages are additive

limitations: Final Rust response byte serialization and bidirectional IPC share one residual phase.
Measurements begin at verified Initial IR and exclude frontend, optimizer, and backend.
Wall-clock samples are machine-dependent and are not byte-deterministic evidence.
Deep-CFG observations characterize empirical scaling; they do not prove asymptotic complexity.
measurement_kind: observational; no absolute timing is a semantic gate

methodology.timing_precision_policy: raw seconds retained; conclusions use bounded aggregate statistics

optimization_candidates.candidate: Remove only provably redundant Python verifier passes.
optimization_candidates.correctness_risk: medium; requires proof that no mutation occurs between boundaries
optimization_candidates.expected_mechanism: Retain one qualified verification boundary instead of verifying the same immutable shadow SSA twice.
optimization_candidates.measured_bottleneck: Python builder verification plus Python shadow verification

optimization_candidates.candidate: Reuse immutable snapshot structures for Python shadow input.
optimization_candidates.correctness_risk: medium; aliasing and same-input proof must remain fail-closed
optimization_candidates.expected_mechanism: Avoid the JSON decode/import copy while retaining one immutable same-input snapshot contract.

optimization_candidates.candidate: Cache or share immutable schema-v2 DTO and canonical forms.
optimization_candidates.correctness_risk: medium; cache invalidation must be impossible or explicit
optimization_candidates.expected_mechanism: Construct each immutable comparison representation once.
optimization_candidates.measured_bottleneck: two result DTO serializations plus two canonicalizations

optimization_candidates.candidate: Replace explicit dominator sets after a separate algorithm qualification milestone.
optimization_candidates.expected_mechanism: Use a dominance representation that avoids the known O(V^2)-space sets.
optimization_candidates.measured_bottleneck: rust_ssa_lowering and Python SSA phases on deep CFG

optimization_candidates.correctness_risk: high; importer is a fail-closed schema boundary
optimization_candidates.expected_mechanism: Profile generated/streamed decoding or fewer intermediate Python objects.

optimization_candidates.candidate: Sample or remove the Python shadow only in a future explicitly authorized milestone.
optimization_candidates.correctness_risk: very high; weakens synchronous fail-closed parity detection
optimization_candidates.expected_mechanism: Execute duplicated safety work less frequently.

cold_first_request.rust_phase_detail: separated Rust compute; final response byte serialization and IPC are combined

scaling_observations.interpretation: The 993 and 1000 samples are similar, while 5000 blocks costs far more than the 5x input-size increase. This is empirical superlinear growth, consistent with the documented O(V^2)-space dominator-set implementation.
scaling_observations.known_component: Python and Rust SSA lowering retain explicit dominator sets documented as O(V^2) space.
